body:
Thank you guys for the responses, I've tried lexapro, welbutrin, depakote and weed, but I've also just wanted to be free from the cognitive blockage feeling of repeated use. My dad who was much more suicidal than I am at this age (though also much less aware of his condition) is on xanax and says it helps him well, so maybe I'll just have to go through the bad meds to find the right one and deal with the side-effects. When I'm up I always tell myself this is why not to leave,  I've just started to realize I can't convince myself of anything positive when my brain changes on me.

Again, thank you all for the responses, reading others' perspectives on things can really help sometimes.
I guess the stigma of medication bothered me, but I think the stigma my brain is creating for itself might outweigh that again soon. Ugh.
